en: Good morning, Kiyo.
Ah... Good morning.

Oh? Well if it isn't Kaito.
Are you feeling better already?

Y-Yeah, somehow... Sorry though, we don't
have much time to talk right now.

Well, don't push yourself. Things feel amiss 
without your boisterious voice.
Yeah, sure. My bad for making you worry.
...Yes, and all because you were scared.
Hm? Did you say something?

I-It's nothing!
Right, Maki Roll!?
...Quit calling me Maki Roll.

Well, I'm glad it's nothing serious...
Things feel amiss without you there.
Good morning, Tenko.
Good morning, Maki!
...Good morning.
Hey, are you ignoring Shuichi?

Huh, what do you mean? It's proper manners
to greet girls before degenerate males.
More importantly, have you guys seen Himiko?

I haven't seen her...
She's not in the dorms?

I guess not. I didn't get an answer after I
knocked on her door, so she must've gone out...

Anyway, I'll go look for her!
If you see her, please let me know!

<CLT=cltMIND>She must want to apologize for last
night. It's very like Tenko to take action...

H-Hey!
Why are you going there!?
I swore off gambling forever!

That was random... Did you see a ghost
in the casino or something?

Wh-Wh-What!? Was there one there?
Where did you see it!?

...I wanted to scare you a little, but I didn't
think you would freak out that much.

G-Geez, Maki Roll!
Don't tease me like that!

When you shout like that, it just makes you
look even more cowardly.

Ooooohhh!
N-Now you've done it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Ahahaha, he's already being
teased about it.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?
<CLT=cltMIND>Pool Entrance Zelda gimmick plant
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Closed)
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Open)
